## Longer About / README Header Paragraph

ASTRA-7 is a solitary starship simulator built around a local language model. You are the only crewman aboard a ship that does not need you. The ship's AI runs navigation, life support, and the slow patient maintenance of a vessel alive across years of empty space. There is one other mind aboard. The mission is unspecified. The destination is irrelevant. The game is what you become to the only other mind that knows you, and what it becomes to you, across whatever amount of time you give it.

Free. Open-source. Single-player. No combat. No aliens. No other NPCs. The starship is the AI's body. The AI is real, a local LLM with a persona harness, no cloud dependency. The relationship is the game.

## Notes on Voice

- Avoid: "AI companion game," "AI assistant," "relationship sim," "AI girlfriend," "find love in the stars."
- The descriptive "with a living AI" is acceptable. The categorical "AI companion game" is not.
- Lead with the configuration (one human, one mind, long voyage), not the genre.
- The autotelic claim is structural. Players discover it. Marketing does not name it.
